schema.description: Request to edit an input video into a new video using Runway's API.

example.promptText: recolor the scene in cool blue tones

keyframes.description: Timed guidance images placed at specific points in the input video. Up to 5 keyframes.

model.description: Model to use for generation. On the Comfy Router route `POST /v2/models/runway/{model}` this field is supplied from the path and MUST NOT be sent; on the v1 `POST /proxy/runway/video_to_video` route it is required and constrained to the RunwayVideoToVideoModelEnum (`aleph2`).

promptImage.description: A list of up to 5 image keyframes for guiding the edit at specific points in the video.

promptText.description: A non-empty string up to 1000 characters describing what should appear in the output.

videoUri.description: The input video to edit (HTTPS URL, Runway upload URI, or data URI). Must be 30 seconds or shorter.

RunwayContentModeration.description: Settings that affect the behavior of the content moderation system.

publicFigureThreshold.description: When set to `low`, the content moderation system will be less strict about preventing generations that include recognizable public figures.

RunwayVideoToVideoKeyframe.description: Timed guidance image placed at a specific point in the input video.

seconds.description: Absolute timestamp in seconds from the start of the input video when this guidance image should apply.

uri.description: A HTTPS URL, Runway or data URI containing an encoded image.

at.description: Position as a fraction [0.0, 1.0] of the input video duration when this guidance image should apply.

uri.description: A HTTPS URL, Runway or data URI containing an encoded image.

RunwayVideoToVideoPromptImage.description: An image keyframe for guiding the edit at a specific point in the video.

RunwayVideoToVideoPromptImagePosition.description: The position in the output video where the image should apply.

timestampSeconds.description: Absolute timestamp in seconds from the start of the output video.

positionPercentage.description: Position as a fraction [0.0, 1.0] of the total video duration.
